mapper.sql: SELECT c.content_id, c.content_no, c.title, c.content_type, c.theme, c.activity_id, c.plan_publish_date, c.audit_status, c.audit_user_id, c.audit_time, c.audit_remark, c.user_id, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, a.activity_name, u.nick_name as user_name, au.nick_name as audit_user_name FROM mk_content c LEFT JOIN mk_activity a ON c.activity_id = a.activity_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON c.audit_user_id = au.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_content (content_no, title, content_type, theme, activity_id, plan_publish_date, audit_status, audit_user_id, audit_time, audit_remark, user_id, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{contentNo}, #{title}, #{contentType}, #{theme}, #{activityId}, #{planPublishDate}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditUserId}, #{auditTime}, #{auditRemark}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_content SET del_flag = '2' WHERE content_id IN #{contentId}
